limitations: English-language local lexical pilot; one expected item per query; review notes were indexed; no tenant grants, native load, task outcome, or hosted route tested.

Translate a medieval Latin poem into Spanish.

positive_results.query: We have fewer usable components than confirmed customer orders. Allocate what is on hand without promising the same unit twice.
Compare direct freight against a cheaper two-hop lane that misses the arrival promise.
For this approved maintenance procedure, identify missing calibrated fixtures and compatible replacement parts before scheduling the repair.
Our subcontractor uploaded a report and marked the job done. Which agreement deliverables still lack signed acceptance?
A contractor is available next week, but approved funds may start later than the work. Can the project request be committed?
Our project responsibility sheet lists the same employee as preparer and independent approver. Check coverage and conflicts.
Separate spent money from open purchase commitments when explaining why a work package differs from its authorized baseline.
This mixed service and equipment invoice could go to several accounts. Propose the right ledger classification from the chart rules.
Show every ledger account and consolidation adjustment behind the reported revenue line, including duplicate mappings.
The vendor bills for units ordered, but only part of the shipment was accepted. Prepare an invoice exception before anyone pays.
The support issue was fixed internally, yet we cannot find the follow-up the agent promised the customer. Is the case finished?
The requested refund includes a unit already credited last month. Check eligible returned quantities and the original sale price.

probe_selection_rule: One author-written task query per proposed method, drafted before running this local evaluator; five unrelated no-answer controls. Not independent or blind.
